response.sql: WITH grouped_avgs AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) as grp_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eventannotm), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(grp_avg) as baseline_val FROM grouped_avgs), above_baseline AS (SELECT ga.grp_avg, (ga.grp_avg - b.baseline_val) as excess FROM grouped_avgs ga CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE ga.grp_avg > b.baseline_val) SELECT AVG(grp_avg) as mean_of_averages, AVG(excess) as mean_excess FROM above_baseline
